name: showtime
description: Animations and a companion pet while the model works: a mascot beside the spinner, a scene above the prompt (a shoot-em-up, Clawd, pixel homages and more), a finale and a pet that levels up, in fourteen themes

visible.title: Show the animations
visible.description: The animations at all: the mascot, the band and the companion (/showtime off and /showtime on change this too)

footerButton.title: Footer button
footerButton.description: A Showtime button in the prompt footer that turns the animations off and on, as /showtime off and /showtime on do

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The animations' look: clawd (Claude's mascot), thunder (a shoot-em-up), chomp, sparky, bluecat, nyan (pixel homages), cat, bunny, sakura, mecha, neon, dino, ocean, matrix, stack, plumber, snake, launch, frogger, kitchen, railway, garden, submarine, random for a new one each session, or rotate for the next one each turn (starting at random). /showtime <theme> switches it live

stage.title: Animation band
stage.description: An animated scene above the prompt (two to four rows, by theme) while the model works (/showtime stage off|on overrides it)

celebrate.title: Finale
celebrate.description: A short finale in the band when a turn ends: confetti and the time it took, or a sad face when interrupted

companion.title: Companion
companion.description: A pet in a row above the prompt: it shows what the model is doing (the tool running, a permission waiting), stays between turns, levels up as turns finish, and a click or /showtime pet pats it (/showtime companion off|on overrides it)

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: Beside the pet: the plan's progress and current task, and a row under the band naming each subagent and what it runs (/showtime feed off|on overrides it). Costs no tokens: it reads the task tools' results and the engine's own events

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Draw the mascot, the band's scene and the pet as still pictures: they still change with what the model does, without moving

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of /showtime's replies and the finale's label; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
